blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Competition Commission of India (CCI) consists of a Chairperson and not less than 2 and not more than 6 Members appointed by the Central Government.
Members and the Chairperson are selected by the Central Government upon recommendations of a Selection Committee headed by the Chief Justice of India or their nominee.
Eligible members must be persons of integrity and standing with at least 15 years of professional experience in law, economics, finance, administration, or trade.
The term of office for the Chairperson and Members is 5 years or until attaining 65 years of age, whichever is earlier, with eligibility for re-appointment.
